content.text: 站长统计 Overview Overview of Fujian Economic Performance Natural Resources Logistics and Transportation Opening Up Si-Tech Innovation Education Resources Medical Institutions Business Environment Overview of districts and cities Overview of Fujian Home Why Fujian Overview Fuzhou Xiamen Quanzhou Zhangzhou Putian Sanming Ningde Longyan Nanping Pingtan Comprehensive Pilot Zone Fujian Province, abbreviated as “Min”, is located on the southeast coast of China, with Fuzhou City as the provincial capital. Our province administers 9 prefecture-level cities—Fuzhou, Xiamen, Zhangzhou, Quanzhou, Sanming, Putian, Nanping, Longyan, and Ningde—as well as the Pingtan Comprehensive Experimental Zone. It also includes 11 county-level cities, 31 municipal districts, and 42 counties (including Kinmen County). Fujian covers a land area of 124,000 square kilometers and a maritime area of 136,000 square kilometers. By the end of 2024, its permanent resident population reached 41.93 million.
